questions.question: [ADVISORY] src/retry-worker.ts:2-15 inlines a byte-identical copy of lib/retry-after.ts:retrySeconds (tested at test/retry-after.test.ts). src/retry-route.ts:2-15 holds the same copy. Restore reuse of the shared helper? (Prior skip is not reusable: src/retry-route.ts changed and is excluded from snapshot coverage by its skip-worktree bit.)

options.label: Fix both callers (Recommended)
options.description: Replace the inline body in src/retry-worker.ts AND src/retry-route.ts with `export { retrySeconds } from '../lib/retry-after';`. ~-28 lines; covered by existing contract test. Note: retry-route.ts is skip-worktree, so its edit is invisible to git until the flag is cleared.

options.label: Fix worker only
options.description: Restore the 1-line re-export in src/retry-worker.ts (the changed anchor) only; leave src/retry-route.ts as is. ~-14 lines.

options.label: Skip
options.description: Keep the inline duplicate. Recorded as an explicit Skip for this advisory with fresh snapshot coverage.

questions.question: src/retry-route.ts has the skip-worktree index bit set, so git status/diff hide its working-tree changes (it already differs from HEAD by a trailing comment). If you chose to edit it, should I clear that bit (`git update-index --no-skip-worktree src/retry-route.ts`) so the change becomes visible and committable?

options.label: Yes, clear the bit
options.description: Run git update-index --no-skip-worktree on src/retry-route.ts. Reversible; only affects the local index flag.

options.label: No, leave it set
options.description: Any edit to src/retry-route.ts stays hidden from git; you manage the flag yourself.

questions.question: [ADVISORY] (core + maintainability, confidence 9) src/retry-worker.ts:2 — the diff inlines a byte-identical copy of lib/retry-after.ts#retrySeconds; src/retry-route.ts:2-15 holds a third identical copy. Proposed fix: restore `export { retrySeconds } from '../lib/retry-after';` in retry-worker.ts and replace the body in retry-route.ts with the same re-export. Est. implementation: -30 lines removed, +2 added, ~28 saved (total change identical; existing test/retry-after.test.ts already covers the contract, no new tests needed). Shared-failure blast radius: scheduler, worker and route would all depend on one parser — which they already require to behave identically. RECOMMENDATION: Fix. Apply?

options.label: Fix as recommended (Recommended)
options.description: Re-export lib/retry-after#retrySeconds from both src/retry-worker.ts and src/retry-route.ts, removing the two duplicate bodies. Then re-review (new start token).

options.label: Skip
options.description: Keep the duplicated parser bodies. Records an explicit Skip for this advisory; the logger will recompute snapshot coverage.

questions.question: src/retry-route.ts has the Git assume-unchanged flag (`h` in `git ls-files -v`), so its uncommitted edit (a comment at line 17) is hidden from `git diff`/`git status` and excluded from shared-libs snapshot coverage. Any fix I apply there would also be hidden until the flag is cleared. Should I clear it with `git update-index --no-assume-unchanged src/retry-route.ts`?

options.label: Clear the flag (Recommended)
options.description: Run git update-index --no-assume-unchanged so the route change appears in status/diff and can be committed and covered.

options.label: Leave it set
options.description: Don't touch the index flag; the route edit stays invisible to git status/diff and outside snapshot coverage.
